# Warlock AI Groq

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-groq`

> Groq adapter for @warlock.js/ai (OpenAI-compatible, thin wrapper over @warlock.js/ai-openai)

## Skills

- [ai-groq](@warlock.js/ai-groq/skills/SKILL.md): Groq adapter for Warlock AI: `GroqSDK`, `GROQ_KNOWN_MODELS`, `GROQ_DEFAULT_PRICING`, `inferVisionCapability` and `inferReasoningCapability`. Use for "connect Groq", fast chat, streaming, tools, model capabilities or pricing overrides through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents and custom tools; @warlock.js/ai-openai for generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
